text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (January 27, 2026) for 66 Pacific Avenue and 65/35/95 High Park Village

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (January 27, 2026), for 66 Pacific Avenue and 65/35/95 High Park Village, Folder No. 26 109561 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to November 30, 2026.
